cap_realizations: independent across caps; shared spatial state across all windows of a cap
conditioning: galaxy observations only; fresh noise at both stages per draw; aligned sampled coarse masses to fine decoder

operator.boundary: finite completed cuboid, free-space cell-average; no subcell correction

primary: per-cell density and ordered eigenvalue fair CRPS
fair Brier and reliability of each class
scoring.sensitivity: finite-ensemble central order statistics with their actual nominal levels; do not label them 90%
scoring.reference: frozen smoothed-count ridge and joint within-cell residual bank trained with leave-one-training-phase-out errors
scoring.primary_population: registered supported core cells with 0.01 <= observed radial z < 0.55
scoring.secondary_weighting: observed gridded CIC counts, not exact galaxy coordinates
scoring.independent_replication_unit: simulation phase, not voxel, cap or draw
diagnostic_only: density PDFs and fixed draw slice maps

required_before_first_confirmation_read: Complete and inspect development reports including matched operator closure
Bind immutable data/geometry production route, model weights, code, normalizer, prior, baseline, scoring implementation and approval to a new confirmation-only release
Derive geometry from observation and registered random support; do not select or replace cells by truth
Separate truth preparation/scoring from the observation-only sampler
Explicit confirmation authorization; do not weaken or reuse the training/development phase guard
on_confirmation_failure: Report all failures with denominators. Do not tune, refit or silently replace a test phase. No claim about DESI coverage.
